trial_court: III Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru (M.C.No. 4158/2020)
facts_of_case: Petitioner seeks transfer of M.C.No.4158/2020 from III Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru to Civil Judge (Sr.Div) and JMFC at Kolar Gold Fields.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking transfer of a case to establish sufficient grounds for such transfer.
legal_principles.held: Perused the petition papers. This petition is filed under Section 24 of CPC with a prayer to transfer M.C.No.4158/2020 filed under Section 13(1)(ia) and (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

legal_principles.principle: A respondent's no objection to a petition for case transfer is sufficient grounds for the court to consider the prayer.
legal_principles.held: The Advocate for respondent humbly submits that the petitioner has filed this case seeking transfer of case from Bengaluru in M.C.No.4158/2020 before the Principal Judge Family Court at Bengaluru. It is further submitted that the respondent has no objection to the prayer of the petitioner.

outcome.final_order: Petition is allowed; proceedings in M.C.No.4158/2020 are transferred from Principal Judge, Family Court at Bengaluru to Civil Judge (Sr.Div) and JMFC at Kolar Gold Fields.

use_for_drafting: practical tips for advocates in Karnataka
